summary.text: Orchard Garden in Mountain is Fairy Li Shan's battlefield immortal killer move. The ground rises into a chain of mountains that cages the target while pear trees and vines fill the valley.

claims.text: Against Hei tribe’s four elders and their ancient battle formation Green City Rampage, Fairy Li Shan finishes preparing and activates this battlefield immortal killer move. The earth rumbles, a mound becomes a mountain, ridges form, and a chain of mountains encircles the green giant over more than a thousand li, like a bowl or a prison. After she stops controlling it, the transformation continues: pear trees grow in the valley with vine-like branches, pear blossoms fall like snow, and vines coil onto the giant’s legs.

Fang Yuan already knows she has this trump card, but the power exceeds his previous life. He judges that Miniscule Mountain, a secluded domain of heaven and earth recorded in The Legends of Ren Zu, supplies the extra dao marks because she placed it in her immortal aperture. Each use expends dao marks permanently, like myriad star fireflies, so records of history show she did not use this battlefield immortal killer move often. Frequent use would drop her own foundation and cultivation level; it is a last resort. The four elders are rank seven Gu Immortals, and Green City Rampage was once ranked third in the world, yet with Miniscule Mountain she temporarily traps the rank eight level green giant.

After dark ember burns most of the pear trees, they keep growing from the ground toward the green giant. When the giant flies, a suction force pulls it down and grows tenfold every several meters, until it slows to a crawl and crashes from only thirty meters up. Fairy Li Shan cultivates information path mainly, and wood path and earth path secondarily. The move combines those two secondary paths: pear blossoms and coiling vines are wood path, and the gravity that pulls the target down is earth path. Without Miniscule Mountain, the original version based on her own strength might have let the green giant break out. Vines and roots also tie Hei Cheng and send him into Fairy Li Shan’s hands. After Nine Dragon Body Protection wrecks the mountains, and ten breaths after Blazing Heaven Demoness leaves with the captives, the move is completely destroyed in a collapse of mountains.

Fang Yuan later notes that battlefield killer moves take a long time to set up. In his previous life, when Fairy Li Shan faced the four Hei tribe elders and Green City Rampage, this move was prepared in advance a while before. He judges that his star soul battlefield cannot rival it at trapping enemies.
